mapper.sql: p.*, u.nickname AS create_by_name, cu.nickname AS confirm_by_name, av.voucher_no AS accrue_voucher_no, pv.voucher_no AS pay_voucher_no

FROM hr_payroll p LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = p.confirm_by LEFT JOIN fin_voucher av ON av.id = p.accrue_voucher_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher pv ON pv.id = p.pay_voucher_id
mapper.update: UPDATE hr_payroll SET headcount = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_payroll_item i WHERE i.payroll_id = #{id}), gross_total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.gross_pay), 0) FROM hr_payroll_item i WHERE i.payroll_id = #{id}), personal_total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.social_personal + i.housing_personal), 0) FROM hr_payroll_item i WHERE i.payroll_id = #{id}), tax_total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.income_tax), 0) FROM hr_payroll_item i WHERE i.payroll_id = #{id}), net_total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.net_pay), 0) FROM hr_payroll_item i WHERE i.payroll_id = #{id}), company_total = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.social_company + i.housing_company), 0) FROM hr_payroll_item i WHERE i.payroll_id = #{id}), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
